name: Enterprise Mesh
tagline: Planned enterprise bundle built on the audit/compliance foundation.
summary: Enterprise bundle concept around OBS-02 and AUD-02, with internal monitoring and quality surfaces as future fleet inputs. Not sellable yet because the bundled vitals/drift surfaces and named third-party integrations are not productized in-repo.
description: Enterprise Mesh is the fleet-contract concept, not a fully ready bundle today. The repository already contains the signed audit evidence needed for OBS-02 and the regulated workflow overlays behind AUD-02. It does not currently contain a buyer-ready fleet dashboard, a production drift-watch module, or first-class Sentry/healthchecks.io integration code. Until those blockers clear, OBS-ENT stays a planned package rather than a sellable contract.
buyer: A team running many agents that wants one enterprise contract once fleet dashboards, quality watch, and support commitments are all packaged together.

features.name: OBS-02 foundation
features.detail: Enterprise audit evidence, signatures, attribution, and retention come from the current audit logger.

features.name: AUD-02 foundation
features.detail: Regulated workflow and reviewer-facing export work come from the current compliance package components.

features.name: Dedicated support
features.detail: Commercial support can be attached to the bundle once the bundled product surfaces are ready.

features.name: SLA
features.detail: Contracted response and uptime terms belong on the enterprise offer once the technical bundle is productized.

source_components.maps_to: Signed audit evidence and compliance-reporting foundation.
Internal monitoring surface that still needs buyer-facing fleet packaging.
Quality-scoring foundation; no production drift-watch module yet.
Healthcare compliance overlay via AUD-02 foundation.
Compliance workflow overlay via AUD-02 foundation.

readiness.blocker: OBS-01 and OBS-03 are not sellable bundled surfaces yet, and the repository has no first-class Sentry or healthchecks.io integration code.
readiness.next_action: Wait for buyer-ready fleet dashboards and drift-watch implementation before quoting OBS-ENT as a real bundle.
